Later NDJSON cleanup for FHIR-31425 is already represented on the combined branch and normalizes wording on the same page without reversing the separate-tab fix. The old in-repository PageProcessor path touched by the 2018 commit is no longer present in the current checkout, so there is no current Java source hunk to reapply.
